title: "Workshop schedule"
subtitle: "A draft for a condensed, in-person version (three days)"

---

::: {.callout-note title="Draft"}
The workshop length is decided after the content (it is built and tested;
see the [build report](https://github.com/khan-lab/cbio7501-f26/blob/main/docs/BUILD_REPORT.md)).
This draft fits the core lessons into three days of about six teaching hours;
the timings come from the lesson estimates and will be tuned after a first run.
Participants do the [setup](pages/00-setup.qmd) before day 1, including the
cache prefetch, and run the [lesson 03 download](pages/03-data-management.qmd#hands-on)
on day 1 morning while the introduction runs.
:::

| Time | Day 1: organize and track | Day 2: environments, reports, containers | Day 3: workflows and sharing |
|------|---------------------------|-------------------------------------------|------------------------------|
| 09:00 | [01 Introduction](lectures/01-introduction/01-introduction.qmd) (slides, 40 min) | [05 Pixi](pages/05-pixi.qmd) Part A | [09 Snakemake](pages/09-snakemake.qmd) §1–5 |
| 10:30 | [02 Project organization](pages/02-project-organization.qmd) + [03 hands-on](pages/03-data-management.qmd#hands-on) | [05 Pixi](pages/05-pixi.qmd) Part B: the pipeline as tasks, the *Reproduce* check | [09 Snakemake](pages/09-snakemake.qmd) §6–11 |
| 12:00 | Lunch | Lunch | Lunch |
| 13:00 | [04 Git](pages/04-git.qmd) §1–6: Git on your laptop and on GitHub | [07 Quarto](pages/07-quarto.qmd) | [10 Nextflow](pages/10-nextflow.qmd) in-class part (40 min); [11 Documentation](pages/11-documentation.qmd) (50 min) |
| 14:45 | [04 Git](pages/04-git.qmd) §7–10: branches, a conflict, pull requests | [08 Containers](pages/08-containers.qmd) §1–6 | [12 Swap and reproduce](pages/12-putting-it-together.qmd) |
| 16:15 | Your own project: apply the day's tools (30 min) | Your own project (30 min) | Wrap-up, checklist, next steps |

**Not in the three days** (self-paced afterwards): [06 Jupyter](pages/06-jupyter.qmd),
[05b Conda comparison](pages/05b-conda-comparison.qmd), Apptainer and
registries in [08](pages/08-containers.qmd), the full
[Nextflow tutorial](pages/10-nextflow.qmd), Zenodo release in
[12](pages/12-putting-it-together.qmd), [S1 packaging](pages/S1-packaging.qmd).
